objective_vision_observations: Page contains three color photographs on a white page with black background edges. Two of the photographs show groups of people with black boxes redacting faces, and one shows a seated older man relaxing on a wicker chair. The top photo shows three people standing outdoors in a courtyard with palm trees and a white building. The middle-right photo shows a man with silver hair in a wicker chair indoors near a large stone wall and an arched doorway. The bottom photo shows two people standing close together outdoors near a blue and white helicopter with another person standing near the helicopter.
